overview:
Silverlight Research is a London-based institutional expert network founded in 2017. Silverlight identifies James Cartwright as its founder and CEO and says he previously worked in Morgan Stanley's investment management and investment banking divisions. Companies House records incorporation of Silverlight Research Ltd on 27 December 2017.

Silverlight says its internal team manages expert sourcing, screening, compliance, scheduling, and documentation. Its current company materials describe full-time staff and coverage across North America, Europe, and Asia. The company lists offices in London, New York, Valencia, Lisbon, Islamabad, and Manila.

The firm describes its services as structured access to independent practitioners for institutional research, rather than investment advice or authored consulting recommendations. Its public materials identify private equity firms, hedge funds, asset managers, consultants, corporate teams, and sovereign wealth funds as users.

history.narrative: Silverlight dates its founding to 2017; Companies House records incorporation on 27 December that year. Its About page, updated 28 July 2026, describes a permanent, full-time leadership, operations, research, and sourcing team. The reviewed primary sources do not establish when this operating model began.

servicesDetailed.name: Written Q&A and Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Silverlight's August 2026 sourcing guide lists written exchanges, expert surveys, group panels, and on-site meetings alongside phone and video calls. Availability and scope should be agreed for the project.

aiPlatform.narrative: A company blog post dated 11 February 2025 says Silverlight is integrating AI and big-data analytics into expert matching. The reviewed current service pages describe database-backed sourcing by an internal team. The blog provides no named AI product or technical validation; it does not establish a self-service AI platform.
